简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (cordis) plugin that registers a `wait_subagent` tool: **block until a background"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" continuable subagent settles, then get its stop reason and closing message** in the same call."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It fills a real gap in the subagent workflow: `run_in_background` returns a `subagentId` immediately"},{"id":"p5s2","text":", but the only way to learn the outcome is an async settlement notice — there was no tool to activel"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" way to learn the outcome is an async settlement notice — there was no tool to actively wait for it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Real output"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Start a subagent in the background, then wait for it:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The call blocks while the subagent runs. When it settles, the tool returns:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The text the model sees:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Other outcomes:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Situation | Result |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Subagent already settled before the call | `{ "status": "settled", "subagent_id": "…", "stop_reaso"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"n": "unknown" }` — *"had already settled before this call; its closing message was delivered separat"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ely as a settlement notice."* |
| `timeout_ms` elapsed | `{ "status": "timeout", "subagent_id": "…" "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"}` — *"Timed out waiting for subagent …; it may still be running."* |
| Caller's `AbortSignal` fired"},{"id":"p15s5","text":" | `{ "status": "cancelled", "subagent_id": "…" }` |
| Unknown / foreign subagent id | Rejected with"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" an error: *"… is not one of your subagents — pass the id a background dispatch returned (see list_a"},{"id":"p15s7","text":" *"… is not one of your subagents — pass the id a background dispatch returned (see list_agents)"* |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"What the subagent system gives you today:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- `subagent` with `run_in_background: true` → returns a `subagentId` at once; work continues asynchr"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"onously and a settlement notice arrives later.
- `subagent` with `run_in_background: false` → blocks"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" at **start** time only.
- `send_message` → fire-and-return, never waits for the answer.
- `list_age"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"nts` → a snapshot, not a wait (and explicitly "not to poll")."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"What's missing: after starting a subagent in the background, there is no tool to **block and wait** "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"for it to finish. That is exactly what `wait_subagent` does — use it when your next action depends o"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"n the subagent's result, instead of guessing or polling."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- Registers the `wait_subagent` tool on every root agent (same pattern as `dsh-proactive`).
- **Memb"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ership gate**: `ctx.subagents.listChildren(parent.id)` — the same projection `list_agents` reads — c"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"overs live AND storage-only children, so unknown ids are rejected with an error instead of being mis"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"reported as settled. A known child absent from the live registry has already settled.
- The tool lis"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"tens for the `subagent/end` lifecycle event — which fires when a child's activation is disposed — sc"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"oped through the plugin context (an ancestor of all agent contexts).
- Settlement removes the child "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"from the live registry and dispatches `subagent/end` in the same synchronous block (`finishDisposal`"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"), so attaching the listener first and then re-checking the registry is race-free.
- Optional `timeo"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"ut_ms` parameter returns `status: "timeout"` if the subagent does not settle in time. Omit to wait i"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ndefinitely — usually the best choice; if set, use a generous value rather than polling with repeate"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"d short waits.
- Respects the caller's `AbortSignal` (returns `status: "cancelled"`)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Tool schema"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Caveat: don't wait and interrupt in the same step"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`wait_subagent` is concurrency-safe, but `interrupt_agent` is not — it needs the tool
lane exclusive"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ly and queues behind any in-flight call. Issuing `wait_subagent` and
`interrupt_agent` in one parall"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"el step serializes them: the wait runs to its timeout
first, and only then does the interrupt land. "},{"id":"p25s4","text":"Call `interrupt_agent` first, then
`wait_subagent` in the next step (an already-interrupted child se"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"_agent` first, then
`wait_subagent` in the next step (an already-interrupted child settles quickly)."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Or straight from GitHub (source install — plain ESM JavaScript, no build step, so pnpm ≥ 10 build-sc"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ript approval is not needed):"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Restart your DSH instance after installing; the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` registers the loader entr"},{"id":"p30s2","text":" instance after installing; the bundled `cordis.patch.yml` registers the loader entry automatically."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Permissions & compatibility"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **What it touches**: registers exactly one model-facing Agent tool (`wait_subagent`) on every root"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" agent. No web client, no UI changes, no configuration.
- **Blocking semantics**: while waiting, the"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" call holds the calling agent's tool lane until the subagent settles, the optional timeout elapses, "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"or the caller aborts — that is the feature. The wait itself is event-driven (`subagent/end` lifecycl"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"e event), not polling; CPU cost while blocked is negligible. An omit-`timeout_ms` wait is unbounded "},{"id":"p32s6","text":"by design; set a generous `timeout_ms` when you need a bound.
- **No side effects**: no network requ"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"ests, no external services, no filesystem writes.
- **Dependencies**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.1.2"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"-rc.1 (aligned with the dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 locked version), Node ≥ 22.5."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Local development"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"That's it — `lib/` is plain ESM JavaScript; there is no build step and no test suite."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Release a new version"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Then publish the tarball to npm and push the version commit and tag:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"Verify with `npm view dsh-wait-subagent version`."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Community"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"- Thanks to the LINUX DO community for providing the discussion environment."}],"truncated":false}
